say_keep_gate_1.speaker: halvard
say_keep_gate_1.text: I had hoped you would turn back. I cannot yield the gate.

say_hall_of_the_flame_1.speaker: maren_sorrel
say_hall_of_the_flame_1.text: The circle is open. Bring your embers here and help me finish it!

say_hall_of_the_flame_2.speaker: maren_sorrel
say_hall_of_the_flame_2.text: The dragon came after the Fall for this heat. Now it wakes. Guard the hearth!
